cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Stay Until We’re Okay
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the relationship feels repaired, even if the practical reason for staying disappears.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The dishes are done. Before you go, are we actually okay?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I stayed to clean up. I've done that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I know. Could you stay for the part that isn't the kitchen?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got ten minutes before the last bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then sit with me for nine. I don't want the last thing we fixed tonight to be the sink.

mechanism: A professionally distinguishes a completed household task from unresolved relationship repair, insisting B stay for a carefully bounded conversation.
confusable: D73 recruits connection through attendance; D74 specifically keeps someone already present after practical work is finished until relationship feels repaired.
comparison: Taxi alternative delays a shared departure for a specific betrayal; dishes alternative separates finished cleanup from still-broken communication under a bus deadline.
seedUse: Finished dishes, cleanup reason, ten-minute bus and nine-minute stay derive from D74-a; S03 adds exact completion and timing corrections.
